query:
SELECT 
  ei.id,
  ei.name,
  ei.brand,
  ei.model,
  c.name AS category,
  c.slug AS category_slug,
  esc.name AS sub_category,
  esc.slug AS sub_category_slug
FROM equipment_items ei
LEFT JOIN equipment_categories c ON ei.categoryId = c.id
LEFT JOIN equipment_sub_categories esc ON ei.subCategoryId = esc.id
ORDER BY c.name, esc.name, ei.name
LIMIT 300;
